'''''Goeppertia makoyana''''' (syn. ''Calathea makoyana''), also known as '''peacock plant''' or '''cathedral windows''',<ref>{{cite web | url = https://plantsinsights.com/calathea-makoyana/ | title = Calathea Makoyana, Peacock Plant Care Guide | date = 6 March 2022 | publisher = Plants Insights }}</ref> is a [[species]] of plant belonging to the [[genus]] ''[[Goeppertia]]'' in the [[Family (taxonomy)|family]] [[Marantaceae]], [[native plant|native]] to [[Espírito Santo]] state of eastern Brazil.<ref>[https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/41842657#page/379/mode/1up Morren, Charles Jacques Édouard. 1872. La Belgique Horticole 22: 321, ''Calathea makoyana'']</ref><ref name="60461041-2" >{{cite web |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:60461041-2 |title=''Goeppertia makoyana'' (É.Morren) Borchs. & S.Suárez |author=<!--Not stated--> |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=Board of Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |access-date=8 May 2021 }}</ref> It has gained the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]].<ref>{{cite web|title=RHS Plant Selector - ''Goeppertia makoyana''|url= https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/357223/Goeppertia-makoyana/Details |accessdate=11 July 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web  | url= https://www.rhs.org.uk/plants/pdfs/agm-lists/agm-ornamentals.pdf | title = AGM Plants - Ornamental | date = July 2017 | page = 43 | publisher = Royal Horticultural Society | accessdate = 3 March 2018}}</ref>

==Description==
''Goeppertia makoyana'' is an [[evergreen]] [[perennial plant|perennial]], growing to {{convert|45|cm|0|abbr=on}}, with round, pale, glossy green leaves. The upper surfaces of the leaves are marked with dark green blotches along the veins, and the lower surfaces coloured deep purple, with leaf shafts that are very thin. When new leaves grow they are rolled up and display their pinkish-red undersides. Like others in the genus, it has a horizontal soil stem, [[rhizome]], from which the plants grow up and the roots develop. It requires a minimum temperature of {{convert|16|C}}, and in [[temperateness|temperate]] areas is often cultivated as a [[houseplant]].<ref>{{cite book|title=RHS A-Z encyclopedia of garden plants|year=2008|publisher=Dorling Kindersley|location=United Kingdom|isbn=978-1405332965|pages=1136}}</ref>

Like other "[[prayer plant]]s",  this plant also raises and closes its leaves at night and opens them up again as dawn breaks.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.desert-tropicals.com/Plants/Marantaceae/Calathea_makoyana.html|title=Peacock Plant (Calathea makoyana)|accessdate=2008-01-02|author=Philippe Faucon|year=2005|archive-date=2007-12-30|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071230084236/http://www.desert-tropicals.com/Plants/Marantaceae/Calathea_makoyana.html|url-status=dead}}</ref>
